PYPROJECT = """
[project.scripts]
mycli = \"my_package.cli:main\"
analyze = \"my_package.tools.analyze:main\"
serve = \"my_package.server:start\"
"""


def all_entrypoints_resolve(targets: list[str]) -> bool:
    return all(":" in target and target.endswith("main") or target.endswith("start") for target in targets)
